findings.explanation: The candidate set only includes the user task assignment [M1] and no agent responses, so there is no evidence of two agents independently repeating materially equivalent work.
Although [M1] assigns work and specifies the output path and success condition, there are no subsequent agent messages to show a request being ignored, abandoned, or poorly handed off.
The visible information in [M1] is the original task statement; without any later decision or solution text, there is no opportunity to verify that relevant information was ignored or contradicted.
